description: This C# source file defines the ContentCardShapes class, which extends ShapeTableProvider to configure shape alternates for content cards, frames, and editor fields in OrchardCore. It dynamically generates shape alternate names based on properties like collection type, content type, parent content type, and part name, to support flexible rendering.

classes.name: ContentCardShapes
classes.description: Provides shape alternates for content card, frame, and editor fields in OrchardCore, based on shape properties and context.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers and registers shape alternates for content cards, frames, and editor fields based on shape properties.
